scripts.build:wasm: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo build --profile wasm-release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features wasm && "$(sh scripts/find_wasm_bindgen.sh)" target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-release/neser.wasm --out-dir web/pkg --target web --omit-default-module-path && wasm-opt -O3 web/pkg/neser_bg.wasm -o web/pkg/neser_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:dev: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo build --profile wasm-dev --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features wasm && "$(sh scripts/find_wasm_bindgen.sh)" target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-dev/neser.wasm --out-dir web/pkg --target web --omit-default-module-path
scripts.serve: [ -d dist ] || { echo "Error: dist/ not found. Run 'pnpm run build' first." >&2; exit 1; } && rm -f dist/roms && ln -s ../web/roms dist/roms && cd dist && exec python3 -m http.server "${NESER_WEB_PORT:-8000}"
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run serve
